revise.description: Change sounds of the batch just applied: step back to before it (it must be the latest edit) and apply it again with `overrides` on top of its actions, as one undo step. Takes no `ids`.
revise.title: Revise

skip_unsure.description: Bulk guard: a cut or shorten over a transcript word below the unsure line (`analysis.unsure_word_confidence`) is not applied. It stays pending and is named in `held` and `held_unsure`; every other sound is applied as one history step, and when all are held nothing is saved. The server checks the saved words at apply time, not a list the client sends. The CLI and MCP send it for the all-suggested path and for several ids (not on revise); naming one id does not. The Studio client does not send it yet. Every guest apply behaves as if it were true.
skip_unsure.title: Skip Unsure

hold_blocked.description: Approve all: a cut that cannot apply safely (another speaker is talking there, say) stays pending and is reported in `held`; every other edit applies. A cut that would cut other speech also stays pending: the reply is reported with its speech evidence. Trusted interactive intent or `override_audio_checks` overrides that acoustic hold. Without `hold_blocked`, one held cut refuses the whole batch.
hold_blocked.title: Hold Blocked

override_audio_checks.description: Apply even if the automatic audio-quality and cut-position checks would hold this edit (a mid-word or harsh cut the owner wants anyway). Allowed for any caller that may run the command; the history entry and applied edits record who overrode and through which surface.
override_audio_checks.title: Override Audio Checks

skip_unsure.description: Bulk guard: a pending cut that covers a transcript word below the unsure line (`analysis.unsure_word_confidence`) is not applied. It stays pending and is reported in `held` with reason `unsure_word`; every other edit applies as one history step. The server checks the saved words at approval time, not a list the client sends. The CLI and MCP approve-all send it; approving one cut by name does not. The Studio client does not send it yet. A guest's multi-edit approve always behaves as if it were true.
skip_unsure.title: Skip Unsure

ClipJoinMode.description: How an incoming clip meets the previous clip at render time.
ClipJoinMode.title: ClipJoinMode

ClipMuteRegion.description:
Source-media span muted inside a clip (mute-in-place).

Render fades the clip out over the span's first ``fade_out_ms`` and back in over
its last ``fade_in_ms`` (an approved tighten mute widens the span by the padded
cut's fades, so the cut itself is silent). ``fill`` is the room tone laid under it
(``tighten.filler_pad_mode: room_tone``), digital silence when None. A clip cut
through the region keeps it whole, so the span may run past the clip's source
edges and the clip stays silent up to its cut edge.
ClipMuteRegion.title: ClipMuteRegion
